ledger_sign_by_kind.name: ledger_sign_by_kind
ledger_sign_by_kind.value:
("ledger"."kind" = 'earn' and "ledger"."amount_paise" > 0)
       or ("ledger"."kind" in ('payout', 'reversal') and "ledger"."amount_paise" < 0)
       or ("ledger"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "ledger"."amount_paise" <> 0)

ledger_status_by_kind.name: ledger_status_by_kind
ledger_status_by_kind.value:
("ledger"."kind" = 'earn' and "ledger"."status" in ('credited', 'pending_review'))
       or ("ledger"."kind" = 'payout' and "ledger"."status" in ('pending', 'paid', 'failed'))
       or ("ledger"."kind" in ('reversal', 'adjustment') and "ledger"."status" = 'credited')

ledger_reversal_has_note.name: ledger_reversal_has_note
ledger_reversal_has_note.value: "ledger"."kind" not in ('reversal', 'adjustment') or "ledger"."note" is not null

packs_collect_consistent.name: packs_collect_consistent
packs_collect_consistent.value:
("packs"."collected_at" is null and "packs"."summary" is null and "packs"."paid" is null and "packs"."played_day" is null)
       or ("packs"."collected_at" is not null and "packs"."summary" is not null and "packs"."paid" is not null and "packs"."played_day" is not null)

prompts_gold_concepts.name: prompts_gold_concepts
prompts_gold_concepts.value:
(not "prompts"."is_gold" and "prompts"."gold_concepts" is null)
       or ("prompts"."is_gold" and "prompts"."gold_concepts" is not null and cardinality("prompts"."gold_concepts") between 1 and 4)

users_city_length.name: users_city_length
users_city_length.value: "users"."city" is null or char_length("users"."city") between 1 and 60
